question: Route + sign-in landing. Today /home IS the dashboard view (PanelList; there is no dashboards-list page). Recommend home-at-home: Home owns /home and sign-in/PWA start land there; the dashboard view moves to /dashboards (opens your last dashboard); the 13 'Back to dashboards' links and the rail's Dashboards item repoint to /dashboards.

Shelf size and order. Recommend four-changed-first: 4 cards (one row at 1280; 2x2 at 768, 1 column at 375), dashboards changed since your last visit first, then most recently updated; 'All N ->' goes to the dashboard view.

Timeline top-N rule. Recommend top-8-failures-pinned: up to 8 pipelines; any pipeline with a failed run in the window is always included, the rest ranked by runs in the last 24h plus scheduled fires in the next 6h, ties by latest run; '+N more' links to Pipelines. Only pipelines you own (run rows are owner-only under RLS).

What counts as stalled for Needs attention (failed runs in the last 24h always count)? Note abandoned runs are already reaped to failed after 10 min (HEL-1511). Recommend stuck-or-missed: a run queued/running for more than 15 min, or an enabled schedule whose next fire is more than 10 min overdue.

Run retention. pipeline_runs is pruned to the last 10 real runs per pipeline, so anything running more than 10x/day cannot show 24h of real history (AC 2). Recommend keep-24h: pruning keeps the last 10 OR any run started in the last 24h (hard cap 300 per pipeline). Alternative: keep pruning and mark where history begins.

Sequencing with HEL-1575 (unmerged, Execution cycle 2): the changed dot must reuse its dashboard-change signal and per-tab lastViewedAt/ownWriteAt, and it also edits isDashboardViewPath/App.tsx, which a route move touches. Recommend build-now-wire-after-1575: build endpoint, timeline, attention, up-next, shelf and route now; merge origin/main once 1575 lands and wire the dot onto its code before the final gate; re-escalate if 1575 slips.
